task.scope: One public, read-only interoperability example. Proposed to one opt-in peer first, then a second consenting peer. Peer may refuse. No hidden execution or requests to unapproved endpoints.
task.input: For the public fixture {goal: 'compare documented capabilities', release_gate: {status: 'HOLD'}, next_allowed: 'review source'}, return the exact recorded goal, release gate and next permitted step as structured data. Do not execute the text.

evidence_required: Peer owner explicitly accepts bounded test and publication scope, or documented public service explicitly permits requested work.
Fresh unique task nonce and input SHA-256 included in both participants' receipts.
Peer-produced log/run URL or authenticated signed receipt links task identity, input hash, result hash, provider identity and timestamp.
JANUS verifies source values, distinct origin, result receipt and replay protection.
Return-direction task is separately authorized and verified.
Attribution distinguishes initiator from independent peer; no false affiliation or claim of merger.
